title: Improve File Watcher in odrun and odrun2
description: Enhance the incomplete file watcher implementation in odrun and odrun2 to provide better file watching capabilities with robust event handling, flexible configuration, enhanced filtering, and improved error handling.

title: Fix findfont curl directory creation issue
description: Address the curl issue in the findfont function in configs.d where curl may not successfully create files if the folder doesn't exist. Create directory structure before attempting to download the file using curl.

title: Create tool to print specific todo card by index
description: Create a new tool in the tools directory that accepts a .kantban file path and x,y coordinates, and prints the specific card at those coordinates. Should handle out-of-bounds errors gracefully.

title: Factor out clampindex function to utility.d
description: Extract the clampindex function from app.d, create a new utility.d file, move the function to the new file with proper imports, and update app.d to import from utility.d.

title: Write fuzzing unittest for clamp function
description: Create comprehensive unit tests for the clamp function, test edge cases like negative indices, max values, empty arrays, add fuzzing tests with random inputs, and ensure all code paths are covered.

title: Simplify app.d
description: Simplify the app.d file to make it more maintainable and easier to understand.

title: Add -ai flag to app.d for screenshot and exit
description: Add a -ai flag that takes a screenshot and exits, using the syntax test I created.

title: Create tool that calls app.d with -ai flag and uses OCR to verify correctness
description: Create a tool that calls the app.d in -ai mode and uses OCR to verify correctness.
